rules.title: How health is decided
rules.red: At risk: a sprint past its end date or 30 percentage points behind its time, 3 or more change requests waiting for the PM, an Awak story failed in the last 7 days, or the Awak budget used up.
rules.amber: Watch: a sprint 15 percentage points behind its time, any contract check waiting for the PM, a contract without an approved baseline, an Awak error, or 80% of the Awak budget used.
rules.green: On track: none of the above.

empty: No project is included. Use the project filter to bring some back.
